_comment: WHY THIS GATE NEEDS A COMMITTED CASE (ADR 0008): this is a NEW instrument
whose verdict may be read by the operator when deciding the 13 landed
receipts' disposition, and nothing downstream re-derives that reading.
Uniformity alone is not a defect: the cases distinguish a copied literal
from a genuine constant, and missing evidence from an empty population.
The historical 13 identical values are not the current corpus population.
All receipts and exec logs here are synthetic. Paths in evidence manifests
are relative to the manifest directory. No real Codex artifacts are used.
Pytest copies these exact case directories under tmp_path; --selftest
copies them to temporary directories. No second set of fixtures exists.
expected_exit and expected_output refine GOOD/BAD into exact verdicts
for selftest and pytest, including the denominator on every clean run.
Evidence confirms a supplied association; these fixtures do not establish
the authenticity of a real receipt-to-log link, which old receipts lack.

cases.name: bad-copied-literal
cases.why: Two identical stored reviewers, but independently supplied evidence derives a different model for review-1.json. Uniformity with disagreement is a finding.
cases.expected_output:
UNIFORMITY-FINDING: review-1.json: stored reviewer='codex/gpt-5.5', cross-verification derived='codex/gpt-6-astra'
UNIFORMITY-SUMMARY: examined=2 verifiable=1 distinct=1

cases.name: bad-empty-corpus
cases.why: Only a skipped receipt: no reviewer was examined. An empty population must never pass as a clean corpus.
cases.expected_output: UNIFORMITY-UNKNOWN: examined=0 verifiable=0 distinct=0 - nothing was examined (empty or misconfigured receipts-dir)

cases.name: bad-unverified-uniform
cases.why: Identical reviewers with no matching evidence manifests. The constant could be copied or true; the checker cannot decide.
cases.expected_output: UNIFORMITY-UNKNOWN: examined=2 verifiable=0 distinct=1 - uniform, but 0 of 2 receipt(s) had verifiable evidence; could not distinguish a constant from a genuinely unchanging model

cases.name: good-diverse
cases.why: Three receipts with two stored reviewers. Diversity raises no uniformity concern, even without evidence.
cases.expected_output: UNIFORMITY-OK: examined=3 verifiable=0 distinct=2 - 2 distinct reviewer value(s), corpus is diverse

cases.name: good-verified-uniform
cases.why: Identical reviewers with one independent confirmation and no disagreement. Rejecting all uniform corpora would falsely flag this GOOD case.
cases.expected_output: UNIFORMITY-OK: examined=2 verifiable=1 distinct=1 - uniform, verified against 1 receipt(s) of exec-log evidence, no mismatch

anchors.why: CONSTRUCTED, not historical, and PERMANENTLY so. A gate introduced by its own pull request has no blind ancestor on main; --verify-provenance will therefore read unverified forever. Integrity is established by the sha256 above, historicity is not. WHAT IT IS: a presence-only checker that treats any nonempty receipt population as clean, never filtering skipped receipts or attempting cross-verification. It MISSES all three known-bad inputs, including the skipped-only population in bad-empty-corpus, and AGREES with the real gate on BOTH known-good cases. Presence is mistaken for examination, and examination for verification. The harness requires the anchor to miss every registered BAD case; this weaker checker demonstrates each missing distinction.
